verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party tool for migrating historical books from another accounting system. What it does show is adjacent: bank and PayPal transaction imports, spreadsheet sync in Advanced, and API/MCP CRUD building blocks that a developer could use to build a migration. The Accountant Suite line describes moving an accounting firm with 'no data migration', which is a different capability. None of this demonstrates migrating historical books with full transaction detail preserved.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail
